questions.question: In which year the number of Arts students is 30% more than that of Science?
questions.solution:
In year 2012

Number of Science students = 250

Number of Arts students = 325

Number of Arts students more than Science students = 325 – 250 = 75

Required percentage = (75/250) × 100 = 30%

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total number of Science students in 2011 and 2015 to that of Arts in 2012 and 2015?
questions.solution:
Total number of Science students in 2011 and 2015 = 225 + 375 = 600

Total number of Arts students in 2012 and 2015 = 325 + 325 = 650

Required ratio = 600 : 650 = 12 : 13

questions.question: The total number of Arts students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 is what percentage less than that of Science in the given five years (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
The total number of Arts students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 = 275 + 350 + 325 = 950

Total number of science students in all five years = 225 + 250 + 300 + 280 + 375 = 1430

Difference = 1430 – 950 = 480

Required percentage = (480/1430) × 100 = 33.56% = 33.6% approx.

questions.question: The average number of Science students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 is what percentage more than the number of Arts students in 2011?
questions.solution:
Total number of Science students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 = 225 + 300 + 375 = 900

Average number of Science students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 = 900/3 = 300

Number of Arts students in 2011 = 275

The number of Average number of Science students in 2011, 2013 and 2015 students more than Arts students in 2011 = 300 – 275 = 25

Required percentage = (25/275) × 100 = 9.09 %

questions.question: If a + b + c = 4 and ab + bc + ca = 1, then the value of a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc is:
questions.solution:
Given

a + b + c = 4

Squaring both sides

a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca) = 16

⇒ a² + b² + c² + 2 × 1 = 16

⇒ a² + b² + c² = 14

Now,

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c)( a² + b² + c² – ab – bc – ca) = 4 (14 – 1) = 52

∴ a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = 52 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**let us assume c = 0 ,

we get a + b = 4 ,ab +0 +0 =1 [ab =1]

to find a3 + b3 

we know that a3 + b3 = (a + b)[(a + b)² - 3ab] 

⇒ a3 + b3 = 4 [(4²) - 3 × 1] = 4 × 13 = 52

questions.question: The vertices A, B, C and D of a quadrilateral ABCD lie on a circle. ∠A is thrice ∠C and ∠D is twice ∠B. What is the difference between the measures of ∠B and ∠C?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/890c157d867186a3805fcaab0d5f98f4c3b988dec258f22b16b4f4291afa9d29.png] 

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle is 180°

∠A + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 3 θ + θ = 180°

⇒ 4 θ = 180°

⇒ θ = 45°

∴ ∠C = 45°

Again,

∠B + ∠D = 180°

⇒ α + 2α = 180°

⇒ 3 α = 180°

⇒ α = 60°

∴ ∠B = 60°

∴ Difference between ∠B and ∠C = 60° − 45° = 15°

questions.question: A, B and C can finish a task in 42 days, 84 days and 28 days, respectively. A started the work. B joined him after 3 days. If C joined them after 5 days from the beginning, then for how many days did A work till the completion of the task?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be LCM (42, 84, 28) = 84

A, 42 days efficiency 2

B, 84 days efficiency 1

C, 28 days efficiency 3

Initially A work for 3 days = 3 × 2 = 6 work

A and B together work for 2 days = 3 × 2 = 6 work

Remaining work = 84 – 12 = 72

Time taken by A , B and C to complete the remaining work = 72/6 = 12 days

∴ A work for = 3 + 2 + 12 = 17 days

The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 6 : 5. Four years ago, the ratio was 5 : 4. What will be the ratio of the ages of A and B after 12 years from now?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of A and B be 6x and 5x

According to question

(6x – 4)/(5x – 4) = 5/4

⇒ 24x – 16 = 25x – 20

⇒ x = 4

∴ Present age of A = 6x = 6 × 4 = 24

And present age of B = 5x = 5 × 4 = 20

After 12 year age of A will be = 24 + 12 = 36 year

And 12 age of B will be = 20 + 12 = 32 year

∴ Required ratio = 36 : 32 = 9 : 8<

questions.question:
The curved surface area and the volume of a cylindrical pole are 132 m² and 528 m³, respectively. What is the radius (in m) of the pole?

(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Given

Curved surface area = 132 m²

Volume = 528 m³

Curved surface area/Volume = 132/528

⇒ 2πrh/πr²h = 132/528

⇒ 1/r = 1/8

∴ r = 8 m

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 8175x45y2 is divisible by 72, then find the largest value of y:
questions.solution:
When the number 8175x45y2 is divisible by 72 then it is also divisible by 8 × 9

If a number divisible by 8 then its last 3 digit must be divisible by 8

5y2 is divisible by 8 when y = 1, 5, 9

∴ Largest value of y = 9

questions.question: If cosec 31° = x, sec 59° cosec 31° − (sec² θ – tan² θ) is equal to:

Given

sec 59° cosec 31° − (sec² θ – tan² θ)

⇒ cosec 31° cosec 31° − 1

⇒ cosec² 31° − 1

⇒ x² – 1

∴ sec 59° cosec 31° − (sec² θ – tan² θ) = x² – 1

In a class of 80 students, 60% participate in games and the rest do not. The average weight of the former group is 5% more than that of the latter. If the average weight of all the students is 51.5 kg, then what is the average weight (in kg) of the former group?
questions.solution:
Total weight = Average weight × Total number

Total weight of all the students = 80 × 51.5 = 4120 kg

We know that 60% of students participated in games

∴ 60% of 80 = 48 students participated in games

And number of students did not participate in games = (80 – 48) = 32

Let the weight of 32 students be x

Weight of 48 students = x + x × 5% = 1.05x

According to the question,

1.05x × 48 + x × 32 = 4120

⇒ x = 50kg

∴ the weight (in kg) of the former groupstudents = 1.05x × 50 = 52.5 kg

questions.question: Amit travelled from A to B at an average speed of 80 km/h. He travelled the first 75% of the distance in two-third of the time and the rest at a constant speed of x km/h. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 80 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be y km

Time is taken by him = y/80 h

75% of the distance = 75% of y = (3/4)y

Time is taken by him to complete the distance of y km = (y/80) × (2/3) = y/120

Rest distance = y&

questions.question: PAT is a tangent to a circle at point A on it, and AB is a chord such that ∠BAT = 72°. If C is a point on the circle such that ∠CBA = 58°, then what is the measure of ∠CAB?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/328a5e1a7d289c3f10dd38b4a9076f6e899165d3c00b7918e8025ab7075044f0.png] 

We know that

∠BAT = ∠BCA ----(angle on the same arc i.e. Arc AB)

∴ ∠BCA = ∠BAT = 72°

In Δ ABC

∠ABC + ∠BCA + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 58° + 72° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° − 130° = 50°

∴ ∠BAC = 50°

questions.question: In a constituency, 40% of the voters are senior citizens. 40% of the senior citizen voters are illiterates and 25% of the non-senior citizen voters are literates. By what percentage is the number of literate senior citizens voters less than that of illiterate non-senior citizen voters?
questions.solution:
Let total voter be 100

Then senior citizens = 40 and non-senior citizens = 60

Number of literates senior citizens = 24

And number of illiterate senior citizens = 16

Also Number of illiterates non-senior citizens = 45

And number of literate non-senior citizens = 15

The number of literate senior citizens voters less than that of illiterate non-senior citizen voters = 45 – 24 = 21

Required percentage = (21/45) × 100 = 46.66%

questions.question: The simplified value of sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65° + sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19° is:
questions.solution:
sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65° + sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19°

⇒ sin 25° cos (90° − 25°) + cos 25° sin (90° − 25°) + sin 71° cos (90 – 71°) + cos 71° sin (90° − 71°)

⇒ sin 25° sin 25° + cos 25° cos 25° + sin 71° sin 71° + cos 71° cos 71°

⇒ (sin²25° + cos²25°) + (sin²71° + cos²71°)

⇒ 1 + 1 = 2

**∴ sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65° + sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19° = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

 sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65° + sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19°

⇒ (sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65°) + (sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19°)

⇒ sin(25° + 65°) + sin(71° + 19°) [∵ sinA.cosB + cosA.sinB = sin(A + B)]

⇒ sin 90° + sin 90° 

⇒ 1 + 1 = 2

∴ sin 25°cos 65° + cos 25° sin 65° + sin 71°cos 19° + cos 71°sin 19° = 2

questions.question: ABCD is a cycle quadrilateral such that AB is a diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 158°. Then ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b2949e6d0b716ac8e014182ed8bcd61e708b92c4d704dac1c83e88e03278933.png] 

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC + 158° = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° − 158° = 22°

In ΔABC

We know that angle made by diameter is 90°

∴ ∠ACB = 90°

Now, ∠BAC + ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 22° + 90° = 180°

∴ ∠BAC = 180° − 112° = 68°
